models.design: Four timber stilts with exposed X braces and a single open plank deck.
Low coursed stone plinth, cantilever braces, open timber upper frame and a front access ladder.
Square stone shaft, stepped corner buttresses and a broad wood fighting platform with low stone merlons.
Narrow tall braced timber lookout on two massive side trestles; one unobstructed firing position.
Offset stone observation pier and a cantilevered split-level timber perch, joined by a visible side stair.
Two separated low firing bays with a central access notch and a shared stone-backed Y-braced trestle.
Three staggered firing platforms: two low side bays and a raised rear centre bay, on a stone-and-timber gantry.
